title: Deep Learning-Based Retinoblastoma Protein Subtyping of Pulmonary Large-Cell Neuroendocrine Carcinoma on Small Hematoxylin and Eosin-Stained Specimens.
authors: Trandafir, Teodora E; Heijboer, Frank W J; Akram, Farhan; Derks, Jules L; Li, Yunlei; Hillen, Lisa M; Speel, Ernst-Jan M; Megyesfalvi, Zsolt; Dome, Balazs; Stubbs, Andrew P; Dingemans, Anne-Marie C; von der Thusen, Jan H
journal: Laboratory investigation; a journal of technical methods and pathology
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习对肺大细胞神经内分泌癌组织切片进行pRb蛋白表达亚型分类，属于纯组织病理图像分类，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点或分子机制建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Molecular subtyping of pulmonary large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC) based on retinoblastoma protein (pRb) expression may influence systemic treatment decisions. Current histomorphologic assessments of hematoxylin and eosin-stained tissue samples cannot reliably differentiate LCNEC molecular subtypes. This study explores the potential of deep learning (DL) to identify histologic patterns that distinguish these subtypes, by developing a custom convolutional neural network to predict the binary expression of pRb in small LCNEC tissue samples. Our model was trained, cross-validated, and tested on tissue microarray cores from 143 resection specimens and biopsies from 21 additional patients, with corresponding immunohistochemical pRb status. The best-performing DL model achieved a patient-wise balanced accuracy value of 0.75 and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve value of 0.77 when tested on biopsies, significantly outperforming the hematoxylin and eosin-based subtype classification by lung pathologists. Explainable artificial intelligence techniques further highlighted coarse chromatin patterns and distinct nucleoli as distinguishing features for pRb retained status. Meanwhile, pRb lost cases were characterized by limited cytoplasm and morphologic similarities with small cell lung cancer. These findings suggest that DL analysis of small histopathology samples could ultimately replace immunohistochemical pRb testing. Such a development may assist in guiding chemotherapy decisions, particularly in metastatic cases.
abstract_zh: 基于视网膜母细胞瘤蛋白（pRb）表达的肺大细胞神经内分泌癌（LCNEC）分子分型可能影响全身治疗决策。目前对苏木精-伊红染色组织样本的组织形态学评估无法可靠区分LCNEC分子亚型。本研究探讨了深度学习（DL）在识别区分这些亚型的组织学模式方面的潜力，通过开发一种定制卷积神经网络来预测小样本LCNEC组织中pRb的二元表达。我们的模型在来自143例切除标本和21例额外患者活检的组织微阵列核心上进行了训练、交叉验证和测试，并配有相应的免疫组化pRb状态。性能最佳的DL模型在活检测试中实现了患者级别的平衡准确率0.75和受试者工作特征曲线下面积值0.77，显著优于肺病理学家基于苏木精-伊红的亚型分类。可解释人工智能技术进一步强调了粗染色质模式和明显核仁作为pRb保留状态的区分特征。同时，pRb缺失病例以细胞质有限及与小细胞肺癌的形态学相似性为特征。这些发现表明，对小组织病理样本的DL分析最终可能取代免疫组化pRb检测。这一进展可能有助于指导化疗决策，尤其是在转移性病例中。
